note: Character-art assets (src/world/characters.ts). `textures`: Poly Haven maps for the procedural fallback body (`maps` limits an entry to a subset of `profile`). `models`: Mixamo characters (FBX with embedded textures) converted to GLB by tools/assets/fbx2glb.mjs; `tex` is the texture long edge. `clips`: Mixamo bones-only animation GLBs copied verbatim. Every entry lists url, author, licence as found, and the committed file sizes; `node tools/assets/fetch-characters.mjs` reproduces the files and rewrites public/assets/CREDITS-characters.md.

mixamoCharacters.name: Mixamo characters (Hugging Face dataset GbotHQ/mixamo-characters)
mixamoCharacters.author: Adobe Mixamo (character artists as credited in the file names, e.g. 'Knight D Pelegrini'); dataset uploaded by GbotHQ
mixamoCharacters.licence: Adobe Mixamo terms (via Hugging Face dataset; no licence file in the dataset)

mixamoClips.name: Mixamo animation clips (Hugging Face dataset Leeoo/mixamo-rigs-clips)
mixamoClips.author: Adobe Mixamo; dataset uploaded by Leeoo
mixamoClips.licence: Adobe Mixamo terms (via Hugging Face dataset; no licence file in the dataset)

textures.author: colormass (photography), Rico Cilliers (processing) / Poly Haven
textures.use: every woven layer of a character: tunic, gown, hose, hood, hats, apron, surcoat, gambeson (the vertex colour carries the dye; the map is neutral grey, 27 cm herringbone twill)

textures.author: Rob Tuytel / Poly Haven
textures.use: the organic layer: skin (fine grain reads as pores), hair and beard, turnshoes, belts, pouches, wooden hafts and the horse (neutral off-white, 30 cm)

notShipped: Converted and inspected but not shipped (too heavy for a crowd / modern dress): Remy 35 k tris, Brian 43 k, Leonard 50 k, Roth 50 k, Timmy 31 k; Ely 14.8 k and Kachujin 12.6 k held back until player creation carries a sex. Sporty Granny 10.7 k (cartoon tracksuit). Checked for the variety pass and rejected: Steve 54.7 k tris, Big Vegas 7.2 k (an Elvis), Prisoner B Styperek 12 k (a zombie), Maw J Laygo 13.9 k (antlered monster), Medea 17.7 k (exports at 0.16 m, modern leotard). No further male civilian body ≤ 8 k tris exists in the dataset's plausible set. Second variety pass (all sheets rendered, none period dress): Heraklios 12.4 k (gas mask), Maria J J Ong 14.6 k (bikini plate), Survivor A Lusth 11 k (ghoul), Romero 49.6 k, Dreyar 14.2 k (sci-fi), Uriel 11 k (gold fantasy plate), Pirate 8 k (sci-fi hood), Akai (conversion failed); Ely turned out a sci-fi trooper. Quaternius/KayKit character packs are itch.io-only, unreachable from the build box. Phase 2 B1 (2026-09-05): box IS online but Option A rejected on evidence — Ely 14.8 k re-rendered (glbsheet) is a sci-fi trooper with glowing chest lights + HE3 chest logo, Kachujin 12.6 k an anime woman in kimono-style mini + thigh rig + leg guards (renders /tmp/ely.png, /tmp/kachujin.png, not committed); both violate the no-modern-dress canon gate, so B1 shipped as Option B procedural frames (lean/medium/sturdy/stout, no new downloads, no manifest/credits change).
